patch.description: The GraphPatch as authored by the brain (or operator).

approver.description: The human identity approving publication — must be distinct from the drafter.

context.description: Policy context — kind allowlist, autonomy ceiling, budget maxima — the publication-surface validator reads.

layeredProcedure.description: Layered merge result the publication service compiles from.

description:
Request DTO for the human-publish endpoint
    (`POST /api/v1/procedures/{projectId}/{procedureKey}/publish`).
    Carries the full publication payload — patch, layered procedure,
    policy context, approver — because the wire shape is the only
    stable contract between Studio and the host's publication service.

    The brain cannot reach this endpoint; the brain drafts patches
(POST /propose-patch) and the human publishes them. The
in-process crown e2e (PHASE 3) calls IPublicationService.PublishAsync
directly via DI; this wire endpoint exists for Studio and any future
Studio-driven publishing UI.

    The patch + layered procedure arrive as JsonElements
because the domain types are not directly wire-serializable
(records with private setters, nested record types the kubb
generator cannot introspect). The host deserializes each element
via JsonSerializer on its way to the publication
service.
